shorts.title: The Genie Who Apologised
shorts.covers: A woman rubs an old lamp and wishes for her ex to regret leaving her; the genie keeps stalling. PLANT: the genie knows exactly how she takes her tea. TWIST: the genie IS the ex, cursed into the lamp for breaking her heart; he goes free only when she wishes for her own happiness instead. She does, and he walks out of her life with a bow.

shorts.title: A Call From 1995
shorts.covers: Mia's old landline rings and a cheerful young woman on the other end says it is 1995; they talk every night and become best friends. PLANT: the woman laughs in a way Mia knows from somewhere. TWIST: it is Mia's mother, who died when Mia was a baby; on the last call Mia gets to tell her that her daughter turned out fine.

shorts.title: Extra Cheese, No Gravity
shorts.covers: Every Friday a pizza order sends delivery rider Sam to an empty field outside town, where the money is left in a box: always gold coins. PLANT: the order note always says 'extra cheese, no gravity'. TWIST: the customers are aliens, and the last order is a job offer: the first pizza franchise in space.

shorts.title: The Night Nurse
shorts.covers: A vampire who can only go out at night falls for a nurse who only works nights, and dreads the day she sees what he is. PLANT: she never eats the hospital biscuits and keeps her blinds shut at noon. TWIST: she is a vampire too, and took the night shift for exactly the same reason.

shorts.title: The Wedding Day Loop
shorts.covers: A bride relives her wedding day over and over, and every time something disastrous happens. PLANT: the caterer always catches the falling cake one second before it falls. TWIST: the caterer is looping too; he has lived this day fifty times trying to tell her she is marrying the wrong man, and on the fifty-first she listens.

shorts.title: The Dragon's Accountant
shorts.covers: A nervous accountant is hired to audit a very old client's 'gold reserves', meeting in a mountain cave. PLANT: the client insists the heating is always on. TWIST: the client is a dragon, and the real problem in the books is that he has spent four hundred years with no one to spend it on; she becomes his first friend and his business partner.

shorts.title: The Lifeguard Who Never Swims
shorts.covers: The beach town mocks lifeguard Nia for never once going in the water. PLANT: she flinches whenever it rains. TWIST: the moment seawater touches her, her mermaid tail returns for everyone to see; when a child is swept out, she dives anyway, and the town that laughed at her cheers.

shorts.title: The Ghost Who Paid Rent
shorts.covers: A broke student rents the cheapest flat in the city because it is haunted, and the ghost leaves her rent money on the table each month. PLANT: the ghost always knows the lunch menu of the hospital across the road. TWIST: he is not dead; he is in a coma in that hospital, and she walks across the road and talks him awake.

shorts.title: The Love Potion
shorts.covers: A shy man buys a love potion from a witch's market stall, drinks it, and finally speaks to the woman at the bookshop. It works. PLANT: the potion 'tastes of nothing at all'. TWIST: it was water; the witch has never sold a real potion in her life, and she is the bookshop woman's grandmother.

shorts.title: Swap Day
shorts.covers: A billionaire's spoiled son and a waiter at his party swap bodies for a day. PLANT: both of them hum the same old lullaby when nervous. TWIST: the waiter is his half-brother, whom nobody ever told him about, and the curse was their grandmother's way of introducing them.

shorts.title: The Queen's Guard
shorts.covers: At a job interview, the young CEO stares at Anya as if he has seen a ghost, and hires her on the spot. PLANT: he stands up and bows slightly when she enters the room. TWIST: in a past life she was a queen and he was the guard who swore to find her in every life; this is the ninth time, and the first time she remembers too.

shorts.title: The Robot Who Lied
shorts.covers: A care robot built never to lie tells a dying old inventor a gentle lie. PLANT: the robot's serial number is the inventor's wedding date. TWIST: the inventor built it forty years ago with one hidden test: the day it lied out of kindness, it would be free. He laughs, and signs its freedom papers.

shorts.title: The Devil's Returns Policy
shorts.covers: On the day his deal with the devil runs out, a successful man waits for the devil to collect his soul. PLANT: his grandmother always made him carry an ace of hearts in his wallet. TWIST: Grandma won his soul back from the devil in a card game forty years ago, and the devil has come only to return the paperwork.

shorts.title: The Star Who Came Down
shorts.covers: A star falls to Earth as a girl to meet the astronomer who has watched her every night for thirty years, and she has only until dawn. PLANT: he holds his telescope very close to his eye. TWIST: he is going blind and this was his last night of seeing stars; at dawn she does not leave, she becomes the light in his eyes.

shorts.title: The Usual
shorts.covers: A stranger walks into Lily's coffee shop and orders 'the usual', though she has never seen him before. PLANT: he knows her name tag is misspelt and calls her by the right name. TWIST: he is her future husband, sent back by her own future self, who told him 'you came in that day and I never knew why'.

shorts.title: The Werewolf's Allergy
shorts.covers: Every full moon Jay vanishes, and his girlfriend Priya is sure he is cheating. PLANT: he sneezes every time her neighbour's dog walks past. TWIST: he is a werewolf, and allergic to dogs; next full moon she turns up at the woods with antihistamines and a very large blanket.

shorts.title: The Runaway Princess
shorts.covers: A princess runs away from an arranged marriage and gets a job at a tiny seaside cafe, where she falls for the owner. PLANT: he folds napkins in a strange pattern she knows from home. TWIST: the owner is the prince she was supposed to marry, who also ran away, and they have been hiding from each other in the same cafe.

shorts.title: Invisible on Monday
shorts.covers: Adam wakes up invisible, and the only person who can see him is Grace, the quiet colleague nobody at the office notices. PLANT: in three years he has never asked her name. TWIST: he turned invisible because he stopped noticing anyone; he becomes visible again the moment he asks her name and means it.

shorts.title: The Last Girl on the Ship
shorts.covers: On a starship crossing between worlds, Ava believes she is the last human awake, kept company by the ship's kind computer. PLANT: the computer hums the same song her brother used to. TWIST: the computer is her brother, who uploaded himself to keep the ship alive; they land together on a green new world.

shorts.title: The Fortune Teller's Horse
shorts.covers: A fortune teller tells Meera she will marry a man with a scar who arrives on a white horse; Meera laughs. PLANT: the fortune teller asks for her address. TWIST: the 'white horse' is a white delivery scooter called Horse, ridden by the fortune teller's grandson, who has a scar on his chin and a parcel with her name on it.

shorts.title: Ice and Fire
shorts.covers: Nell freezes everything she touches when she is upset, so she avoids people. PLANT: the new man upstairs keeps setting off the smoke alarm. TWIST: he sets things on fire when he is nervous; holding hands, the two of them are exactly room temperature.

shorts.title: The Book That Wrote Back
shorts.covers: Jo writes a note in the margin of an old library book, and the next week someone has written back. PLANT: the handwriting matches the author's signature on the title page. TWIST: the replies come from the author himself, writing in 1923, and the book's last page, which she had never read, is dedicated to her by name.

shorts.title: Lost Luggage From Mars
shorts.covers: An airport baggage handler opens a humming suitcase and finds a tiny lost alien. PLANT: his strict manager asks every single day whether any bags are unclaimed. TWIST: the alien is the manager's son; she has been on Earth for twenty years, and the hug at the lost property desk is the best thing he has ever seen.

shorts.title: The Apprentice Who Failed
shorts.covers: A witch's apprentice fails every spell before her final exam. PLANT: the old cat in the corner of the exam room keeps nodding at her. TWIST: her spells were working all along, on the examiner's cat, who was a man cursed three hundred years ago, and who now stands up and hands her the top mark.

shorts.title: Floor Zero
shorts.covers: A lift in an office building has a floor zero that lets you live one day again; Leo uses it to stop his girlfriend leaving. PLANT: the lift is always already on floor zero when he calls it. TWIST: she has been using it too, the same day, and they finally meet on floor zero, both trying to say sorry first.

shorts.title: Cupid on Strike
shorts.covers: Cupid stops shooting arrows and the city's love life collapses. PLANT: he keeps buying flowers from the same florist every morning. TWIST: Cupid has fallen in love with the florist, and the one person he can never shoot is himself; she asks him out first.

shorts.title: The Ghost Wedding Planner
shorts.covers: A wedding planner who happens to be a ghost helps a nervous bride with everything. PLANT: the ghost knows the groom's family's secret biscuit recipe. TWIST: the groom is the ghost's grandson, and she has stayed thirty years just to see him married; after the first dance she waves and is gone.

shorts.title: The Exchange Student
shorts.covers: The Kapoor family's new exchange student is clearly an alien and very bad at hiding it, and the family pretend not to notice. PLANT: the Kapoors never seem surprised by anything. TWIST: the Kapoors are aliens too, from a different planet, and everyone has been pretending to be human for each other's sake.

shorts.title: The Sleeping Curse
shorts.covers: Rose has been under a sleeping curse for a hundred days, and every prince in the kingdom has tried a kiss and failed. PLANT: her best friend Lila has sat by her bed every single day. TWIST: the curse breaks with true love of any kind; Lila kisses her forehead to say goodbye, and Rose wakes up laughing.

shorts.title: The Author
shorts.covers: A woman starts hearing a voice narrating her life and argues with it. PLANT: the voice knows things she has never told anyone. TWIST: the author is herself at eighty, writing her younger self the courage to take the job, the flight and the chance, and the last line the old woman writes is 'go'.
